findings.location: Greetings of love in the blessed name of our Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ.
findings.source_quote: Greetings of love in the blessed name of our Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ.
findings.suggested_fix:
Use the plural "Saudações" to match the English plural "Greetings": replace "Saudação de amor" with "Saudações de amor" (preserve the surrounding

tags).
findings.translation_quote: Saudação de amor no abençoado nome de nosso Senhor e Salvador, Jesus Cristo.

findings.location: He chose and called “disciples” to follow and learn from Him.
findings.source_quote: He chose and called “disciples” to follow and learn from Him.
findings.suggested_fix:
Use the more natural, internationally intelligible form "dele" (lowercase E is also acceptable but keep theological reverence only if style requires). Replace "d'Ele" with "dele": e.g., "para seguirem e aprenderem dele" (preserve the surrounding

tags and quotation marks).

findings.location: Later He sent them out two by two to teach and make more disciples.
findings.source_quote: Later He sent them out two by two to teach and make more disciples.
findings.suggested_fix:
Translate the idiom "two by two" into a clearer Portuguese equivalent such as "de dois em dois" or "em duplas". For example: replace "os enviou aos pares" with "os enviou de dois em dois" (preserve the surrounding

tags).
findings.translation_quote: Mais tarde, Ele os enviou aos pares para ensinar e fazer mais discípulos.

findings.location: These brothers have both graciously accepted this calling and are already allowing God to use their spiritual gifts to make a difference
findings.source_quote: These brothers have both graciously accepted this calling and are already allowing God to use their spiritual gifts to make a difference
findings.suggested_fix:
Add the missing terminal punctuation (a period) at the end of the paragraph to match the source punctuation. Insert a period after "fazer a diferença" (preserve the surrounding

tags).
findings.translation_quote: Esses irmãos aceitaram graciosamente este chamado e já estão permitindo que Deus use seus dons espirituais para fazer a diferença

findings.source_quote: Throughout the article (example: "follow and learn from Him", "two by two", "Greetings")
findings.suggested_fix: Adjust a few phrasings for internationally neutral, natural Portuguese (examples above). These are stylistic/idiomatic suggestions (not changes of meaning): use "Saudações" (plural), "de dois em dois" or "em duplas" (for "two by two"), and "dele" instead of the archaic contraction "d'Ele", unless the publication style explicitly prefers the contraction.
findings.translation_quote: Various (e.g., "Saudação de amor", "os enviou aos pares", "d'Ele")
